name: Pferdeschlittenfahrt im Ötztal
beschreibung:
=== description ===
Fairytale-like through the snowy winter landscape: A horse-drawn sleigh ride through the Ötztal is a romantic experience for the whole family. Cozy under thick wool blankets, you glide gently through the quiet beauty of the white wonder. A stop at a mountain hut with warm mulled wine and toasted almonds completes the experience.
